title: Designing and assembling my first PCB
summary: A personal account of designing and assembling a PCB for the first time, likely documenting the learning journey, tools used, and practical challenges encountered during the hardware development process.
problem_solved: Enables hobbyists and makers to create custom electronic circuits by guiding them through the complete PCB design and assembly workflow from concept to physical board.
why_valuable: Provides a real-world beginner perspective on PCB creation, demystifying the hardware design process and encouraging more developers to venture into physical computing projects.
